design: Threshold-blind, purposive geographically quota-balanced held-out panel
scope: Newly collected cities held out relative to the R61 reference 71; not a claim that nobody has studied these cities, nor random representativeness.
blindness: No pc, error, screening, centrality, degree-summary, or morphology criterion used for roster, fallback, inclusion, or retention.
inclusion: Named city outside R61 reference 71; finite geocoded centre; exact frozen 10-km bbox drive extraction; simple undirected graph after self-loop/isolate removal has at least 2 nodes and 1 edge; finite node coordinates. No lower size cutoff, morphology cutoff, threshold/error screen, or outcome exclusion.
fallback_rule: Use only this slot's frozen fallback after primary acquisition fails within 3 total attempts or has a documented structural/geocoding failure. Retain all failures. Never activate fallback because of graph size (beyond nonempty minimum), topology, pc, predictor error, or decision performance.
transfer_caveat: Decoded HTTP response bytes, not exact VPN/wire accounting; one in-flight response may cross the stop budget. Local raw cache plus two graph pickles expected below a few GB.
r61_extraction: graph_from_point(geocode(city,country), dist=10000, dist_type='bbox', network_type='drive', simplify=True, retain_all=False, truncate_by_edge=True)
simple_conversion: G.to_undirected(); nx.Graph; remove self-loops; remove isolates; default-order integer relabel retaining source OSM IDs. The conversion follows the recorded reference extraction protocol; isolate removal is explicit.
topology_hash_definition: SHA256 of compact sorted JSON containing sorted OSM node IDs and sorted canonical undirected OSM-ID endpoint pairs. Identity-sensitive, not an isomorphism hash.
limitations: Not probability sampling; 21 city centres are not whole municipal footprints.
Contemporary OSM coverage and snapshot time can differ from R61.
Same OSM source means held-out cities, not an independent data-source validation.
Quota balance alone does not validate any prediction or decision guarantee.
